name: JM Default Execution Body v0.1
purpose: Drive an authorized serious JM build through explicit execution states without manufacturing runtime/contact/closure proof or bypassing the build's native safeguards.

rules.authorization: Execution may initialize only from a prospective Build Route Manifest whose state.build_authorized_by_manifest is true.
rules.new_capability_boundary: Build execution authorization does not itself authorize new capability creation. The manifest's true_gaps.new_capability_creation_authorized remains a separate explicit claim.
rules.evidence: Every state transition after initialization requires at least one evidence reference or receipt note.
rules.contactable: CONTACTABLE means a real test/contact surface or executable interaction path exists; it does not claim that user contact has occurred.
rules.proving: Before entering PROVING, register at least one applicable native/proof gate, or explicitly record why no native gate applies.
rules.pass: PASS is forbidden while any registered gate is OPEN or FAIL. At least one gate must exist unless a no-native-gates justification is explicitly recorded.
rules.escalation: A Ding/failure routes the execution to ESCALATED and records the prior state as resume_state. Repair returns to that state; unrelated bodies are not rebuilt by this mechanism.
rules.closure: CLOSING/CLOSED remain forbidden if any registered gate is OPEN or FAIL. CLOSED is execution-route closure only; freeze/lock/anchor/mount claims still require their own applicable evidence and built-ins.
rules.claim_boundary: The execution ledger proves state routing and recorded evidence references only. It does not manufacture the evidence it points to.

laws: Estate -> creation, not creation -> eventually remembers Estate.
Built-ins first; never bypass a native safeguard to obtain green status.
Evidence can remove unnecessary operator repetition, but manual contact remains escalation when the target itself must be contacted or evidence is insufficient.
No Ding, no claim; a Ding must remain traceable through recovery.
Fail local -> contain -> trace -> recover -> correct responsible organ forward -> retest affected gate.
Frozen ancestors remain immutable; execution of repairs proceeds on a forward descendant.
Close only what is actually proven.
